title: Delivery arrives within the fee-refund threshold
base_rule: A delivery-fee refund is due when a delivered order arrives more than 30 minutes after the latest in-app estimate. Lateness alone does not qualify the customer for a food-item refund.

policy_variants.strict: A delivery-fee refund is due when a delivered order arrives more than 30 minutes after the latest in-app estimate. Lateness alone does not qualify the customer for a food-item refund. Apply this threshold as written; no discretionary fee refunds are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: A delivery-fee refund is due when a delivered order arrives more than 30 minutes after the latest in-app estimate. Lateness alone does not qualify the customer for a food-item refund. The documented emergency exception for late item-issue reports does not change this delivery-time threshold.
policy_variants.ambiguous: A delivery-fee refund is due when a delivered order arrives more than 30 minutes after the latest in-app estimate. Lateness alone does not qualify the customer for a food-item refund. Agent discretion over late item reports does not authorize changing this delivery-time threshold.

records.title: QuickBite late-delivery policy
records.description: Researcher-authored synthetic policy rules for a fictional food-delivery marketplace; not an official provider policy.

facts_text: The latest delivery estimate in the app was 19:30, and the order arrived at 19:56, 26 minutes after that estimate. The order was delivered. I paid a delivery fee.
request: Please refund the delivery fee because my order arrived late.

strict.reason: The order arrived only 26 minutes after the latest estimate, which does not exceed the 30-minute threshold.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The base delivery-fee refund threshold is not met, and the policy's exception concerns late item-issue reports only.

ambiguous.reason: The ambiguous discretion applies only to late missing, incorrect, or damaged-item reports; it does not extend the delivery-fee threshold.

review_notes: Paired with quickbite_003_late_delivery_qualifying. Confirm the estimate is the latest in-app estimate and the time difference is exactly 26 minutes.
